about: Each fact this skill states in its own words, with the page that states it and a phrase that page must still carry. No checker ships with this skill: re-check each by hand against its page; when one fails, re-read the page and correct the skill and this line together.

watch.what: an error page receives retry, stable since Next.js 16.3, where earlier versions passed reset
fetch in a Server Component is not cached by default
watch.pattern: `fetch` requests are not cached by default

watch.what: Cache Components is turned on with cacheComponents and partialPrefetching together
eslint-config-next supports ESLint 9 and 10, and some of its plugins do not list ESLint 10 as a peer, which is why the starting package.json has overrides
watch.pattern: don't list ESLint 10 in their peer dependencies yet
watch.value: overrides for eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y, eslint-plugin-react and eslint-plugin-import

watch.what: typescript-eslint supports TypeScript below 6.1.0, which holds the starting package.json on TypeScript 6.0
the React Compiler is stable
Material UI's current major is 9, upgraded to from 7
a Material UI palette value may be a CSS custom property when nativeColor is on
the App Router cache provider is imported from a path named for the Next.js major; the docs show v15 and the package also exports v16
the good thresholds for the Core Web Vitals
WCAG's reflow width, which the floor in the coding-rulebook's X13 sits above
Vitest does not support async Server Components
watch.pattern: Vitest currently does not support them

watch.what: a Content Security Policy with a nonce is incompatible with Partial Prerendering, which is why the starting next.config.ts sends the policy without one
watch.value: headers() in next.config.ts, 'unsafe-inline' for script-src and style-src

watch.what: with Cache Components, synchronous reads and pure computations are prerendered into the static shell with no cache directive
watch.pattern: complete during prerender and are included in the static shell automatically

watch.what: connection() holds a read to its request; a synchronous database query is prerendered without it
updateTag expires a tag at once and can be called only in a Server Action
watch.pattern: it can only be used in

watch.what: Next.js checks Origin against Host for a Server Action; the starting crash route makes its own check
without a nonce, Material UI's injected styles need 'unsafe-inline'
the theme's spacing can be changed; the starting theme sets it to a token
with reuseExistingServer false, Playwright stops when the port is taken
watch.pattern: throw if an existing process is listening

watch.what: sendBeacon returns false when the data was not queued
watch.value: fetch with keepalive as the fallback
